findings.summary: INTRODUCED BY 8ae3a4f, does not block, filed to #319: the shim validates the slug's SHAPE, not its VALUE, and ignores the issue number entirely. /^repos\/[^{]/ rejects only the {owner}/{repo} spelling, so mutating the slug to a wrong-but-LITERAL repo, or the issue number to a constant, each leave the suite 153/153 green — independently reproduced by the orchestrator (wrong literal slug → 0 FAIL, exit 0). The guard installed against R7-M1 catches one spelling of the defect rather than the defect. Non-blocking: the shipped gate is correct at head, verified live against two repositories, and no consumer exists (D3/D4 unbuilt).

INTRODUCED BY 8ae3a4f, filed to #319: the new spawn pin is one reordering away from vacuous. A shim that ignores the body and serves a fixed REFUSED render leaves 153/153 green, including the check named '...and the spawned run refused the BARE body, not a staged one' — its discrimination rests on the last stageRender before the spawn block having staged a DISPATCHABLE body, and nothing pins that ordering. The comment overstates what is pinned.

ruledOut: R7-B1 CLOSED AND OBSERVED IN CI, not asserted: at head with NO gh anywhere on PATH and a scrubbed env (env -i), the suite is 153 ok / 0 FAIL / exit 0; on the PARENT 77d1fcf the identical invocation is 148 ok / 2 FAIL / exit 1, reproducing R7-B1 exactly as round 7 described; CI run 36414522225 shows the step 'The admission gate is connected' SUCCESS at 8ae3a4f where run 36408767717 shows it FAILURE at fae3041 — the red-to-green flip is observed in CI. The only remaining job failure at 8ae3a4f is the missing review record, which this record supplies; the --live step is skipped by design on pull_request.

no path reaches the network from the offline arm: the gate's only child processes are gh and git, there is no fetch or node:http, and with gh absent entirely the suite is green — a surviving network call would have been ENOENT, not a pass

R7-M1 CLOSED, demonstrated live from a foreign cwd: from the vfkb-claude-plugin checkout with --repo at vfkb, the PARENT admitted plugin issue #45 as dispatchable while printing that repo's ADRs; at head the same invocation returns NOT DISPATCHABLE exit 1 with vfkb#45's governing ADRs. The wrong repository is no longer reachable through --repo.

the shim was attacked as infrastructure — it cannot answer a call the gate should not make (unknown body, missing html+json header and placeholder slug each exit 2), readFileSync(0) with no stdin is handled, and it leaks no state between runMain calls
#319 describes every residual it names accurately and completely; two gaps (F1, F2) are to be appended
every claim in 8ae3a4f's commit message was checked against observation — the round-7 blocking finding was a false green claim, so this was re-verified rather than trusted
no AI attribution in the range; no secrets; tree clean
